rules: Each person occupies one cell, and only one.
On a given level, no two people ever share a row or a column.
From one level to the next, if allowed: two people can stand exactly one above the other.
A room drawn across two levels is a single room — the parlour and its mezzanine are one.
The murderer is the only other person present in the volume where the victim lies.
Doors don't open on a button: they open once you've proven something.

case.title: No. 12, Rue des Ormes
case.tagline: They searched the ground floor. Nobody thought to look up.
case.intro: Solange Vaneau was found in the morning in the back kitchen of her house on the Rue des Ormes. Seven people spent the night under that roof. The house has three levels; for now you hold the key to only one.

tapis.front: in front of the kitchen rug

window.on: in front of the street window
window.front: in front of the street window

lit.near: at the foot of the bed

escalier.near: at the foot of the stairs

portemanteau.front: in front of the coat rack

goulotte.name: the coal chute
goulotte.found: A coal chute cuts through the boiler-room wall and comes out in the back kitchen, exactly where the body was found. The two rooms are one.

gateEscalier.title: The stairway door
gateEscalier.locked: A set of keys was left under the kitchen rug — and under the keys, a padlocked hatch. Those keys belong to whoever was standing on that rug. Establish who, and the stairs open.
gateEscalier.opened: The keys belonged to Mathilde Crevier. The stairs are open. The hatch, and its padlock, remain.

gateTrappe.title: The hatch padlock
gateTrappe.locked: The padlock key never left the bedside table in the upstairs bedroom. Establish who occupied that room.
gateTrappe.opened: The bedroom belonged to Gaspard Nourry. The hatch opens onto a servants' stair.

gateGoulotte.title: The boiler room
gateGoulotte.locked: One man is missing from the roll call, and he is nowhere on the two levels you've searched. Find him below.
gateGoulotte.opened: Aubin Ferry never came back up that night. And behind him, in the wall, the coal chute.
